mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_config (id, title_suffix, description_template, og_image_url, ga_measurement_id, twitter_handle, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{titleSuffix}, #{descriptionTemplate}, #{ogImageUrl}, #{gaMeasurementId}, #{twitterHandle}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title_suffix = EXCLUDED.title_suffix, description_template = EXCLUDED.description_template, og_image_url = EXCLUDED.og_image_url, ga_measurement_id = EXCLUDED.ga_measurement_id, twitter_handle = EXCLUDED.twitter_handle, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE site_config SET title_suffix = #{titleSuffix}, description_template = #{descriptionTemplate}, og_image_url = #{ogImageUrl}, ga_measurement_id = #{gaMeasurementId}, twitter_handle = #{twitterHandle}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
